data.name: Rune Fighters
data.detailed_description:
Rune Fighters is a side-scroller 2D magic action cast'em'up couch-co-op/versus featuring a world where every pixel is physically simulated.

Players can create spells from runes, to burn enemies, blow them away with wind, or protect themselves.

The game features to main game modes:

The arena pits friends against each other or against waves of ennemies, so prove your worth as the greatest mage. Make sure to create a diverse spell loadout to counter enemy spells!

The campaign lets players roleplay as overly-aggressive peace-bringers, as you travel through a medieval-fantasy world filled with goblins and fiends, with the simple goal of purging the land of all evil beings - no matter the cost. Unlock runes and equipment by finding them across the levels, and increase your spell loadout options!

Wishlist Rune Fighters to enlist in the ever-growing army of peace-mages!

data.short_description: Rune Fighters is a magical action-packed run'n'cast adventure game set in a world where every pixel is physically simulated. Use self-created spells to burn your friends or fight waves of enemies in the arena, and restore peace in the fiend-filled medieval-fantasy world through the campaign.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit (ver. 2004 or later)
  • Processor: AMD FX-8350 / Intel® Core™ i5-3330
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Yet to be tested on weaker hardware.
